title: Get Wisdom

questions.question: Hear, O sons, a father's instruction, and be attentive, that you may gain what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 4:1 (ESV): "and be attentive, that you may gain insight,"

questions.question: The beginning of wisdom is this: Get wisdom, and whatever you get, get what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 4:7 (ESV): "Get wisdom, and whatever you get, get insight."

questions.question: Keep your heart with all vigilance, for from it flow the springs of what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 4:23 (ESV): "Keep your heart with all vigilance, for from it flow the springs of life."

questions.question: Do not enter the path of the wicked, and do not walk in the way of the what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 4:14 (ESV): "and do not walk in the way of the evil."

questions.question: Turn not to the right or to the left; turn your foot away from what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 4:27 (ESV): "turn your foot away from evil."

questions.question: Prize her highly, and she will exalt you; she will honor you if you do what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 4:8 (ESV): "she will honor you if you embrace her."

questions.question: She will place on your head a graceful garland; she will bestow on you a beautiful what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 4:9 (ESV): "she will bestow on you a beautiful crown."

questions.question: The path of the righteous is like the light of dawn, which shines brighter and brighter until what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 4:18 (ESV): "which shines brighter and brighter until full day."

questions.question: But the way of the wicked is like what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 4:19 (ESV): "The way of the wicked is like deep darkness;"

questions.question: Put away from you crooked speech, and put devious talk far from whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 4:24 (ESV): "and put devious talk far from you."

questions.question: For I was a son to my father, tender and the only one in the sight of my what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 4:3 (ESV): "tender and the only one in the sight of my mother."

questions.question: Take hold of instruction; do not let go. Guard her, for she is your what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 4:13 (ESV): "Guard her, for she is your life."

questions.question: For they cannot sleep unless they have done wrong; they are robbed of sleep unless they have made someone do what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 4:16 (ESV): "they are robbed of sleep unless they have made someone stumble."

questions.question: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 4:17 (ESV): "and drink the wine of violence."

questions.question: Let your eyes look directly forward, and your gaze be straight before whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 4:25 (ESV): "and your gaze be straight before you."

key_verse_text: Keep your heart with all vigilance, for from it flow the springs of life.
